_comment: Hand-maintained inventory for the Dell 2816 port map: what is physically on each port, beyond what the MAC table shows. Keys are port numbers (g1..g16).

6.detail: 6 ports, all 10/100 (4 PoE+, 60 W budget). Feeds roof cameras, sauna-temp and unifi-bateau (100 m PoE run).
6.note: Its 10/100 ports cap this link at 100 Mb/s. Cable test 2026-11-27: "open" at ~14 m = the pairs a 10/100 port leaves unused, not a broken cable.
